facts.fact: The Interior Ministry says its civil-status management system (SGEC) is generalised across all civil-status offices in the Kingdom and handles birth declarations, with over 1,300,000 acts declared or issued.
facts.system: Systeme de gestion de l'etat civil (SGEC)

facts.fact: The Interior Ministry says the SGEC handles death declarations as well as births, marriages and divorces.
